profile.headline: Software Engineer at Workday
profile.summary: Software in nodeJS, JS frameworks (angularJS 1.x and 2+, reactJS), PHP, MYSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hyper-converged Infrastructure Team    
    - Build reusable UI components in Angular
    - Write unit and e2e tests (Jasmine / marbles)
    - Write new features in company's #1-selling data analytics product

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
nodeJS (8.0): 
    - Build microservice architecture and features (expressJS, MYSQL, w/ jasmine testing)
    - Build / maintain interface between internal CMS (Eloquent PHP), Google's DFP, and a private supply-side platform
    - Refactors: Plan and coordinate architecture refactor
    - object-oriented + functional (Lodash, etc.)

Angular v1.x and 2+
    - Responsive user interfaces (HTML5, SASS, CSS3, etc)
    - Refactor: Update our angular1.x to be more performant and upgrade-ready

Testing: 
- create company's first integration tests (jasmine)

Dev tools: 
- docker, gulp / webpack, git, etc

positions.title: Operations Associate - Team Captain
positions.description:
- Lead a team of 5 in providing corporate mentors to 500 returning veterans across the US
- Oversee staff outreach to veterans at 200 US colleges and universities
- Use incoming veteran demographics to predict trends in mentor demand

positions.title: Development and Communications Associate
positions.description:
- Coordinate all proposal and report submission for $4M nonprofit, working with foundations, corporations, and government employees. 
- Write funding proposals, resulting in over $500,000 in revenue.
- Write press releases for news and website publication.
